svg.title: Courtyard House — original dimensioned concept plan
svg.desc: A fictional 12 by 12 metre single-storey home arranged around a 3.6 by 4 metre courtyard. It contains living, dining, kitchen, bedroom, bathroom, study, utility and gallery zones. Original illustrative concept, not a construction drawing.

g.text: A contemporary single-storey Malaysian courtyard-home concept
Dimensions in metres. Gross geometric areas include walls. Room labels are indicative planning zones.
Plan and model share authored coordinates; no client drawings, site records or real property data were used.
Furniture, access and finishes are illustrative. Not an approved design, survey or construction-ready plan.
